tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search current hiring posts from Reddit's job subreddits, newest first. With no filters, returns the newest open jobs. Each result has pay, type, location, skills, any scam warning, the Only Hiring link and the Reddit link to apply.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: One job's full details: summary, pay, skills, languages, test task, how to apply, the opening of the post, and its scam score with the red flags behind it. Also answers "is this Reddit job post a scam?" for a post on the board.

tools.name: list_subreddits
tools.description: The subreddits Only Hiring reads, with how many open jobs each has and what gets posted there. Use a name as search_jobs' subreddit filter.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_jobs, get_job · Public sink: get_job.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_jobs, get_job · Public sink: get_job

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
